summary_en: A quiet Sunday. Barnabé tried Umia Finance's newly launched testnet and said it shows the potential of fully onchain venture funding with futarchy primitives such as conditional tokens. Starknet launched private swaps via avnu. brucexu_eth explained why he started onchain arbitrage research in a bear market. The EIPs repo saw only CI-related submissions.
